# Any of (`or`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Logic · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when at least one nested condition is true.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `conditions` | list of conditions | yes |  | At least one of these must be true. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: or
    conditions:
      - type: time
        after: "22:00"
      - type: time
        before: "06:00"
```
